annotations.title: Where a job or a task stands

description: Where the newest job (or the given one) stands: stage, review mode (quality or lean) and critic round, what is verified vs assumed, and the next command. With task (the id a long tool such as render or transcribe answered with when it ran past the call's time limit): whether it still runs and its latest progress; once it has finished, its full result. Each task call waits up to about 20 s.

job.description: job folder or job name (default: the newest job under showtime-out/)

task.description: a task id from a long tool call, e.g. render-20260928-141500-a1b2

name: status
